title: 2015 Indian heat wave
displaytitle: 2015 Indian heat wave

titles.display: 2015 Indian heat wave

extract: In May 2015, India was struck by a severe heat wave. As of 3 June 2015, it caused the deaths of at least 2,500 people in multiple regions. The heat wave occurred during the Indian dry season, which typically lasts from March to July with peak temperatures in April and May. Although it typically remains hot until late October, Indian monsoons often provide some respite from the heat.
